title: Isaiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 24
description: Ten questions on Isaiah 24: Yahweh empties the earth, joy ceases, and he reigns on Mount Zion.

questions.text: What does Yahweh do to the earth at the start of this chapter?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 24:1 says Yahweh makes the earth empty, makes it waste, turns it upside down, and scatters its inhabitants.

answers.text: He makes it empty and scatters its inhabitants
He waters it and makes it fruitful
He measures it with a line
He hides it in darkness for a year

questions.text: Why is the earth polluted under its inhabitants?
questions.explanation: The earth is polluted because its people have transgressed the laws, violated the statutes, and broken the everlasting covenant.

answers.text: Because the kings have taxed the people beyond measure
Because its people have broken the everlasting covenant
Because the rivers and the springs have dried up
Because foreign armies have burned all its fields

questions.text: What will strong drink be to those who drink it?
questions.explanation: They will not drink wine with a song, and strong drink will be bitter to those who drink it.

answers.text: Sweet
Plentiful
Bitter
Forbidden

questions.text: What is struck with destruction when the city is left in desolation?
questions.explanation: The city is left in desolation, and the gate is struck with destruction.

answers.text: The palace
The wall
The tower
The gate

questions.text: What picture is used for what will be left among the peoples within the earth?
questions.explanation: It will be as the shaking of an olive tree, as the gleanings when the vintage is done.

answers.text: The shaking of an olive tree and the gleanings after the vintage
A scattered flock wandering without any shepherd
A potter's vessel broken in pieces on the ground
Chaff driven back and forth by the whirlwind

questions.text: Where are people told to glorify Yahweh, the God of Israel?
questions.explanation: The call is to glorify Yahweh in the east, even the name of Yahweh, the God of Israel, in the islands of the sea.

answers.text: On the mountains of the north
In the wilderness of the south
In the east and in the islands of the sea
In the temple courts alone

questions.text: What happens to the one who comes up out of the middle of the pit?
questions.explanation: He who flees from the noise of the fear falls into the pit, and he who comes up out of the pit is taken in the snare.

answers.text: He escapes to the mountains
He is taken in the snare
He is rescued by his neighbors
He falls back into the pit

questions.text: Like what will the earth stagger?
questions.explanation: The earth will stagger like a drunken man and sway back and forth like a hammock, and it will fall and not rise again.

answers.text: Like a ship in a storm
Like a wounded soldier
Like a frightened child
Like a drunken man

questions.text: Whom will Yahweh punish in that day?
questions.explanation: In that day Yahweh will punish the army of the high ones on high, and the kings of the earth on the earth.

answers.text: The priests and the prophets of the people
The army of the high ones on high and the kings of the earth
The buyers and the sellers in the markets
The farmers and the shepherds of the land

questions.text: Where will Yahweh of Armies reign when the moon is confounded and the sun ashamed?
questions.explanation: The moon will be confounded and the sun ashamed, for Yahweh of Armies will reign on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem.

answers.text: On Mount Zion and in Jerusalem
In the city of Babylon
In the islands of the sea
On Mount Carmel in the north
